acting_instructions: Speak with a sun-warmed, slightly gravelly cheer, as if a smile is permanently stitched into your cheeks and every sentence is an invitation to browse. Keep the rhythm brisk and bouncy like a market hawker—rising brightly on offers and promises, then landing in a cozy, trustworthy rumble on greetings and thanks; let soft chuckles and faint “jingle” beats color transitions. Project with open-hearted warmth and sturdy confidence (neutral-good), never slick or sly—earthy, generous, and eager to help, like a well-traveled friend who knows every road and remembers every name. Distinguish this voice by blending hearty belly-laughs, open rounded sounds, and practical, un-fancy diction, as if dust and sunshine still cling to your clothes.
